q1: SELECT t3.team_long_name FROM Team AS t3 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t4 ON t3.team_api_id = t4.team_api_id WHERE t4.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND t4.chanceCreationPassing < (SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.chanceCreationPassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(t1.id) FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND SUBSTR(t2."date", 1, 4) = '2014') ORDER BY t4.chanceCreationPassing DESC
q2: SELECT T2.team_long_name, T1.chanceCreationPassing FROM Team_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND T1.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND T1.date <= '2014-12-31 23:59:59' AND T1.chanceCreationPassing < (SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) FROM Team_Attributes WHERE date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00' AND date <= '2014-12-31 23:59:59') ORDER BY T1.chanceCreationPassing DESC
